title: Martin Gardner finds his own lost book

tellings.quote: One day Martin was perusing a used bookstore when he came across a familiar title.

plain: Martin Gardner, a writer on mathematics and puzzles, was once browsing in a used bookstore when he came across a familiar title, and it turned out to be a lost book of his own. Michael Shermer, a researcher billed on the show as America's top skeptic, tells this without naming his source. He mentions it alongside the statisticians Persi Diaconis and Frederick Mosteller, as an example of how a striking coincidence can happen by plain chance.
